comment: Perfboard layout (title drawn as 'Bontempo') of a tap-tempo/modulation daughterboard for a PT2399 delay: ATtiny84 plus MCP41100 digital pot, with a wiring diagram, underside and etched PCB repeating the same parts. Regulator and MOSFET are printed only with pin letters on the perfboard view; their part numbers (78L05, BS170) are read from the wiring diagram. An off-board tempo LED is wired but not listed; the Tap momentary footswitch is listed as a switch because it is a control, not the bypass.
rows: regulator, pins I G O; part number from the wiring diagram
MOSFET, pins S G D; part number from the wiring diagram
